newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania sees lower sugar production in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania sees lower sugar production in 1996/97.

text.p: Tanzanian sugar authorities on Tuesday forecast 1996/97 (July/June) sugar production at about 100,000 tonnes compared to 120,000 tonnes in 1995/96.

The 100,000 tonnes of sugar, worth an estimated $45 million, is around half of Tanzania's through-put production capacity of 200,000 tonnes, Sugar Development Authority General Manager George Mbati told Reuters.
Tanzania's domestic demand is currently running at 280,000 tonnes a year with the shortfall made up by exports, Mbati said.
